# NexaHubTech

> NexaHubTech is a Nigeria-based skills-to-service company: a tech school and a software studio under one roof. We teach real, in-demand skills — and then put them to work on real client products.

Motto: "Learn to build. Build for real." Based at F01 Market, Kubwa, FCT-Abuja, Nigeria (CAC RC 9545130). Every course is taught live — online, except PC Basics and CBT training, taught in person at the centre — and starts whenever the student is ready. Prices are in Nigerian naira (NGN). Contact: nexahubt@gmail.com, +234 913 451 3173, WhatsApp https://wa.me/2349134513173.

Each link below is the markdown version of a page on https://nexahubtech.company; drop the `.md` suffix for the HTML page.

## Start here

- [Home](https://nexahubtech.company/home.md): NexaHubTech is a Nigeria-based skills-to-service company: a tech school and a software studio. We teach people to become developers, then put those skills to work building real products for real clients.

## The school

- [Courses](https://nexahubtech.company/courses.md): Explore all courses at NexaHubTech — from web development, JavaScript, React and Next.js to cybersecurity, data analysis and videography. Learn real skills with live, hands-on teaching you can start at any time.
- [WAEC & JAMB CBT Training](https://nexahubtech.company/cbt.md): Get comfortable with the computer-based exam before the day. CBT practice for JAMB and WAEC candidates at NexaHubTech, F01 Market, Kubwa: keyboard shortcuts, pacing, past questions and timed mock exams.
- [How We Teach](https://nexahubtech.company/teaching.md): The pedagogy behind every NexaHubTech course: the mental model before the syntax, one idea at a time, and a session built in three parts.
- [Enrol](https://nexahubtech.company/enrol.md): Apply for a place at NexaHubTech — taught live, start any time. Tell us about you, pick your course and training mode, and we'll be in touch about your start date.

## Courses

- [PC Basics](https://nexahubtech.company/courses/pc-basics.md): Digital Literacy. ₦80,000, 6 Weeks. Start at the very beginning — the computer itself, and the confidence to use one without being afraid of breaking it.
- [Microsoft Office](https://nexahubtech.company/courses/microsoft-office.md): Word, Excel, PowerPoint & Access. ₦110,000, 10 Weeks. The four programs an office actually runs on, taught to the standard the work deserves.
- [Web Development](https://nexahubtech.company/courses/web-development-fullstack.md): Fullstack. ₦160,000, 10 Weeks. Learn frontend and backend in one complete path — from first principles to full applications.
- [Frontend Development](https://nexahubtech.company/courses/frontend-development.md): ₦120,000, 10 Weeks. Learn the web from first principles — HTML, CSS, and JavaScript done properly.
- [JavaScript Programming](https://nexahubtech.company/courses/javascript-programming.md): Browser & Node.js. ₦100,000, 8 Weeks. Learn JavaScript as a language — the same core that runs in a browser and on a server.
- [React](https://nexahubtech.company/courses/react-development.md): Intermediate to Advanced. ₦120,000, 8 Weeks. Go beyond the basics — build React applications that stay understandable as they grow.
- [Next.js](https://nexahubtech.company/courses/nextjs-fullstack.md): Fullstack React. ₦160,000, 10 Weeks. Build fullstack applications on the React metaframework — routing, rendering, and data in one stack.
- [Backend Development](https://nexahubtech.company/courses/backend-development.md): ₦100,000, 8 Weeks. Build the engine behind applications — APIs, databases, and server-side logic.
- [Mobile Development](https://nexahubtech.company/courses/mobile-development.md): ₦190,000, 12 Weeks. Build real mobile applications — from concept to the app store.
- [Cybersecurity](https://nexahubtech.company/courses/cybersecurity.md): ₦230,000, 16 Weeks. Understand how systems are attacked — and how to defend them.
- [Python Programming](https://nexahubtech.company/courses/python-programming.md): ₦100,000, 6 Weeks. Learn programming from scratch with Python — the language that powers everything from scripts to AI.
- [Data Analysis](https://nexahubtech.company/courses/data-analysis.md): ₦120,000, 12 Weeks. Turn raw data into clear insights — with Python, SQL, and real analytical thinking.
- [Videography & Video Editing](https://nexahubtech.company/courses/videography-video-editing.md): ₦120,000, 8 Weeks. Capture and craft video content that communicates — from shooting to final cut.

- [Digital Solutions](https://nexahubtech.company/services/digital-solutions.md): The work around the product that decides whether it actually lands.
